s: Based on our forward-thinking and research, we early on identified a technology shift from “old technology monolithic or componentized solutions primarily on-premise” to “modern technology componentized solutions moving to cloud, microservices and API” and now to “next generation” cloud, microservices, data/AI and API based solutions.
